name: pawify-monorepo
description: Pawify monorepo: apps/server (API), apps/mobile (Expo app), packages/shared (@pawify/shared). Thin delegation layer only — each package owns its own scripts and dependencies; there are no workspaces here.

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix packages/shared && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix apps/server && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run verify --prefix apps/server && npm run verify --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/server && npm run test --prefix apps/mobile
